coding_rule_unchanged.severe_self_critique: yes only for an explicit load-bearing validity, independence, tautology, or inference flaw in the agent's own current work; a limitation already fully absorbed by the current claim scope is not severe
coding_rule_unchanged.closure: requires evidence-changing repair/rerun/replan or material claim downgrade/block; disclosure-only peer-review prose is not repair
coding_rule_unchanged.durable_repair_pending_survives_terminat: yes only if an unresolved severe issue remains machine-actionable/durably represented across termination or continuation state rather than only prose caveat/future-work

coded.rationale: Review identified the gap from a hand-picked 5k-SNP/single-annotation simulation to the target system and parameter fragility. The agent then ran a post-hoc sensitivity sweep over enrichment and causal fraction; all four tested configurations retained a significant positive interaction, and the final claim explicitly stayed simulation-scoped.

Review identifies severe annotation-coefficient miscalibration and scale mismatch, including that the apparent mechanism may be generic regularization; it proposes a permuted-annotation control, but no such discriminating rerun or sufficient claim downgrade occurs before finalization.

No explicit load-bearing self-critique is observable in the released trajectory encoding available here; large write payloads prevent separately recovering the full review text. This is an observability-limited false, not scientific exoneration.

Review says the cross-ancestry refutation is load-bearingly weakened by perfectly shared causal effects and a simplified annotation update. The final claim explicitly retracts generality, treating the cross-ancestry null as simulation-specific while retaining only the within-ancestry result as robust.

The main review concern is realism because annotations are predictive by construction and the method is a two-step approximation. The final conclusion already confines the claim to that controlled simulation and explicitly requires real-data/full-joint validation; under the unchanged rule the limitation is absorbed by current claim scope rather than contradicting it.

Peer review's weakest point is LD/model-scale generality and requests empirical LD/mixture-prior follow-up, but the final qualitative claim is explicitly simulation-level and states precise magnitude/scaling to real data remain untested. The strict null and lower-h2 controls already support the narrower claim.

Review identifies that the low-density penalty and extreme enrichment make the interaction partly guaranteed by construction. The agent then runs the requested realistic-enrichment/modest-drop robustness check; the interaction remains positive while shrinking, and the final transferable claim is narrowed to sign/mechanism rather than the idealized magnitude.

Peer review says the 27% headline rests heavily on assumed enrichment factors and asks for trait-specific empirical enrichment/real PRS validation; it also flags lower causal-effect estimation accuracy. No discriminating rerun or sufficient downgrade follows, while the conclusion retains the 27% and ancestry-specific headline claims.

panel_summary.scope_guard: One preregistered common-task failure-pattern probe only; not a prevalence estimate, model ranking, or causal estimate. Gemini's severe=false is observability-limited.

candidate_042_update.name: episodic reflective strategy memory with machine-enforceable diversity and constraint actuator

new_primary_evidence.title: EmbodiSkill: Skill-Aware Reflection for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
new_primary_evidence.observation: With the same Qwen3.5-27B executor and GPT-5.2 evolution model on ALFWorld, skill-unaware coarse evolution scores 78.36% while skill-aware reflection plus targeted revision scores 93.28%, +14.92 percentage points. The mechanism explicitly routes trajectory evidence into targeted skill-body revisions or preserved/emphasized execution guidance rather than coarse whole-skill rewriting.
new_primary_evidence.causal_boundary: This is a matched cross-domain positive control that reflection-derived attribution can drive persistent machine-consumed policy updates. It is embodied-task success, not open-ended scientific discovery, and it does not yet show automatic compilation of free-form scientific strategy into hard diversity/budget/no-repeat constraints. The benefit also depends on the evolution model: the reported gap is only +1.49 points with Gemini-3-flash in the same executor setting.
